04/21.07.2023 Heard the Parties.

Petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Kotalpokhar P. S. Case No. 09/2023,
registered under Sections 467/ 468/ 420/ 353/ 186/ 379 of the Indian Penal Code, Rules 04/54 of
the J.M.M.C. Rules 2004, Rules 07/09 of the Jharkhand Minerals (Prevention of Illegal Mining
Transportation and Storage) Rules, 2017, Section 21 of the Mines and Minerals (Development and
Regulation) Act, 1957, pending in the Court of learned A.C.J.M., Rajmahal.
Truck of the petitioner bearing registration number JH- 16-G-8939, transporting stone chips was intercepted by Kotalpokhar police on 26.03.2023.
The driver of the vehicle produced challan for transporting stone chips.
Later on, it transpired that the said challan was of 13.03.2023 and on the date of the occurrence the challan was not valid.
It was submitted that the driver of the vehicle without the knowledge and consent of the petitioner was transporting the stone chips.
It was further submitted that the petitioner has got no criminal antecedent and this fact has been mentioned at paragraph 09 of the anticipatory bail application.
Regard being had to the facts and circumstance of the case; I am inclined to extend the privilege of Anticipatory Bail to the petitioner.

He is directed to surrender before the court below within two weeks from the date of receipt of copy of this order and learned court below on his surrender shall release him on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 25,000/- (Twenty five Thousand only) with two Pakku Ghosh vs The State Of Jharkhand ... ...
